jscore.audio.turned_off: Turned off: %s. Press %s again to undo.
jscore.audio_channel.alerts.about: Alarms and warnings, which ask to be heard over the rest.
jscore.audio_channel.ambience.about: The room itself: the hum of many machines together.
jscore.audio_channel.devices.about: What you work by hand: a drive's tray, a disc going in, a server sliding into its rack.
jscore.audio_channel.interface.about: What a screen says back to you: its clicks and its chimes.
jscore.audio_channel.machines.about: Fans, drives, pumps, presses: every machine that runs.
jscore.audio_channel.music.about: Music played by computers and machines.
jscore.configuration.balance.hdd_latency: How long a hard disk drive takes to find what it is asked for, in ticks.
jscore.configuration.balance.nvme_latenc: How long an NVMe drive takes to find what it is asked for, in ticks.
jscore.configuration.balance.operation_p: How many ticks a queued Operation waits for each level of priority it gains; 0 never raises it.
jscore.configuration.balance.operation_w: How long an Operation waits on a locked resource or a busy machine before it gives up, in ticks.
jscore.configuration.balance.orphaned_op: How many hours a saved Operation nobody resumed waits before it is discarded; 0 keeps it for ever.
jscore.configuration.balance.program_mac: The real time one machine may spend running its programs in a tick, in microseconds.
jscore.configuration.balance.program_ser: The real time every machine together may spend running programs in a tick, in microseconds.
jscore.configuration.balance.ssd_latency: How long a solid-state drive takes to find what it is asked for, in ticks.
jscore.configuration.balance.subframe_ef: The share of its own capacity a Subframe lends the Mainframe it works for.
jscore.configuration.balance.tooltip: How the Operations engine waits and shares its work, and how long programs run.
jscore.configuration.config_version.tool: The version of this file's layout. The game upgrades an older file to it; leave it as it is.
jscore.configuration.media.download_kilo: How many kilobytes a second the server sends each player of the recordings they are about to hear.
jscore.configuration.media.max_file_mega: The biggest recording a player may bring, in megabytes; 0 takes none.
jscore.configuration.media.player_quota_: How much of the server's store the recordings one player brought may take, in megabytes; 0 sets no limit.
jscore.configuration.media.tooltip: The recordings players hear and bring: how much of the connection they take, and how big one may be.
jscore.configuration.media.upload_kiloby: How many kilobytes a second a player sends the server of a recording they bring.
jscore.media.broken: The recording did not arrive whole
jscore.media.busy: Wait for the recordings already on their way
jscore.media.held: The server keeps %s recordings, %s MB in all
jscore.media.no_taker: Nothing on this server takes recordings for that
jscore.media.prune_failed: The recordings could not all be taken out: %s
jscore.media.pruned: Took out %s recordings nothing had used for %s days, %s MB in all
jscore.media.quota_full: You have brought %s MB of the %s MB this server keeps for each player
jscore.media.store_closed: The server keeps no recordings right now
jscore.media.too_big: The recording is larger than the %s MB this server takes
jscore.media.unreadable: Not a recording this server can read
jscore.media.uploads_closed: This server takes no recordings from players
jscore.operation.failure.crashed: the Operation ran into a problem: %s (%s)
jscore.operation.failure.no_result: the Operation finished without saying what it did
jscore.operation.failure.self_test: the self-test ran past what its numbers can hold
jscore.sound_mixer.alerts_on_screen.tip: Shows a sign at the top of the screen, pointing where an alert comes from.
jscore.sound_mixer.channels_note: A channel plays at its own volume times the game's volume for the category it belongs to.
jscore.sound_mixer.key_note: Turn Off Last Sound silences whatever you heard last. Press it again within 5 seconds to bring it back.
jscore.sound_mixer.lower_under_alerts.ti: While an alert plays, the other channels are turned down so it is heard.
jscore.sound_mixer.muffle.tip: Walls between you and a sound muffle it, more with every wall.
jscore.sound_mixer.no_preview: This sound is made as it plays, so there is nothing to play here.
jscore.sound_mixer.title: Sound Mixer
